title: Magmar's Rest Is a Lava Bath
premise: When wounded or tired, Magmar uses lava like a hot spring to recover.
audiencePromise: Follow Magmar from a wounded dip to a full lava soak, then see why the hot-spring comparison fits.
openLoop: How does Magmar turn a lava bath into recovery?
payoff: Magmar's lava bath handles both wounds and weariness, matching the hot-spring comparison in its Pokédex.
engagementQuestion: Healing method or extreme endurance test?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly, warmly, and with playful disbelief. Stress lava, tired, heal, and hot spring. Pause briefly before each reveal.

scenes.headline: HEALING IN LAVA
scenes.narration: Magmar heals wounds by dipping them in lava.
scenes.caption: MAGMAR HEALS IN LAVA

scenes.headline: DIP THE WOUND
scenes.narration: The Pokédex says Magmar can heal a wound in lava.
scenes.caption: A LAVA DIP CAN HEAL A WOUND

scenes.headline: IT GOES FURTHER
scenes.narration: But tired Magmar goes further: it leaps into a volcano.
scenes.caption: TIRED? LEAP INTO A VOLCANO.

scenes.headline: MAGMA EASES WEARINESS
scenes.narration: Then it soaks its body in magma to ease its weariness.
scenes.caption: A MAGMA SOAK FOR WEARINESS

scenes.headline: ITS BODY BURNS CONSTANTLY
scenes.narration: Its body burns constantly, and magma eases its weariness.
scenes.caption: CONSTANT FIRE. MAGMA RECOVERY.

scenes.headline: WHAT WOULD YOU CALL IT?
scenes.narration: Healing method or extreme endurance test?
scenes.caption: HEALING OR ENDURANCE?
